alex: Morning — found a weird perf regression after yesterday's runtime build.

alex: Nightly profiling shows FP8 path dropping throughput ~22% for our 4-bit fallback cases when batch_size>16.

maya: ugh. any logs? or a kernel choice mismatch?

alex: paste logs:
```
[profiler] model=redwood-7b quant=fp8->int4 fallback: kernel_cutlass_sm80 chosen, latency=12.4ms, throughput=78 tok/s
[profiler] same request on sm86: kernel_triton_fp8 chosen, latency=9.8ms, throughput=105 tok/s
```

raj: looks like arch detection picked sm80 for some nodes. did the arch-prober change land?

alex: No, but build flags changed: CUTLASS_TUNE=ON toggled in last release. ci-bot deployed 2026-03-02 03:12 UTC.

ci-bot: deployment notice — runtime-build/2026-03-02-0312 completed, artifacts: s3://redwood/runtime/2026-03-02-0312/

maya: can you repro locally with profiler + --kv-prefetch=on ? suspect KV cache miss pattern + batching heuristic interaction.

alex: repro steps I used:
1) checkout release/2026-03-01
2) run ./serve --model redwood-7b --quant profile.yaml --batcher-strategy=adaptive --batch-max 64
3) send mix of short/long sequences (len 8/512)

alex: When I flip --batcher-strategy=fixed stride=8 throughput recovers but latency tail worsens. So heuristic interplay.

sophie: Calibration sampling stride may be biased. If calib picks tokens only on short sequences, per-head scale for int4 becomes miscalibrated for long sequences -> fallbacks to slower kernels.

raj: interesting — were we using uniform sampling for calibration? last patch switched to reservoir sampling for memory reasons.

maya: can you capture quant scales during runtime? quick patch:
```
// dump qscale for layer 12
logger.info("qscale[l12]=%f seq=%d batch=%d", qscale, seq_len, batch_id);
```

alex: dumped qscales. short seq qscale ~0.022, long seq qscale ~0.048. That difference triggers selected kernel variant (4-bit vs fused fp8) in kernel selector.

maya: so 2 issues: cali-sampling bias + cutlass tuning picks poorly for some archs. proposal:
- revert CUTLASS_TUNE default
- change calibration sampler to stratified by seq_len
- add arch-override env for repro

sophie: +1. also add a small regression test that asserts throughput within 10% across seq_len buckets.

raj: I'll roll a canary build with CUTLASS_TUNE=OFF and stratified sampler. canary id: runtime-canary-18321

alex: TY. if canary shows improvement let's schedule a hotfix. tagging @eng-oncall in case fallout.

maya: baseline numbers for quick comparison:
- master (pre-change) throughput=110 tok/s
- problematic build throughput=86 tok/s
- with stratified sampler + tune=off throughput=108 tok/s

alex: great — I'll attach profiler flamegraphs and raw traces in the ticket.

sophie: nice triage. followup: update evals to include mixed-precision latency SLOs per sequence-length.

alex: ack. will open PR for sampler change and RETAIN CUTLASS_TUNE behind feature flag.

maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
